title: Scope and bound approved sales order profit evidence queries
description: A user opens the existing order-profit report and sees only approved nondeleted sales orders within the current ERP customer scope. Recheck identity and existing order-profit menu each HTTP request; missing db/user/menu or unmapped user must fail closed. Require resolved scope in the existing report service and update all existing callers/tests; do not expose a scope-free bypass. Validate an inclusive date window of at most 366 days before reads, including date overflow; use end-next-day exclusive SQL comparison and stable OrderDate descending/Id tie order. Read at most 501 scoped headers to enforce a 500-order cap and at most 10001 nondeleted details to enforce a 10000-detail cap; overflow returns an explicit report-limit error and no partial/misleading rows or amounts. Only then resolve product/customer data by scoped IDs using fixed batch queries, with no per-order reads or unbounded loading. Existing estimation arithmetic is addressed by the dependent monetary-semantics task; this increment establishes authorized bounded order evidence. Development only: reuse existing ERP order-profit menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit; remain read-only. No client-supplied identity/scope/rows/amount totals, permission expansion, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Keep unrelated work. Run focused in-memory unit/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Unavailable external environment acceptance must be marked environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Every legacy order-profit HTTP request rechecks identity/menu/current ERP scope and the service requires scope; only approved nondeleted scoped orders and nondeleted details contribute, with no unauthorized names or amounts.

Inclusive dates are limited to 366 days and validated before reads; scoped SQL queries enforce 500 orders/10000 details, fail explicitly on overflow without partial rows and use stable date/Id ordering with fixed batch lookups.

Tests cover missing identity/db/menu, unmapped/revoked scope, excluded draft/cancelled/deleted records, date boundaries, stable ties and cap overflow; existing report tests and safe Release build/test pass.
